title: Transcriptome data of CD34+ human cord blood-derived cell treated with UM171, SR1 or both
description: mRNA profiling of CD34+ human cord blood-derived cell treated with UM171, SR1 or both Overall design: mRNA profiles of CD34+ human cord blood-derived cell treated with DMSO (control), SR1 [500nM], UM171 [35nM] or combination SR1 [500nM]+ UM171 [35nM] for 30min, 3hr, 12hr, 24hr, 48hr, 72hr were generated by deep sequencing
